title: Core Credit for Exchanged Units on KestrelCare Repairs
content:
**Note.** A core credit is taken from a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair payment for the exchanged unit, read from the vehicle system on the decision being paid: an engine or transmission repair gives the powertrain core credit of 4 percent, a drive axle, transfer case or steering repair the driveline core credit of 2 percent, and any other repair none.

| Vehicle system | Core credit |
|---|---|
| engine, transmission | 4 percent |
| drive axle, transfer case, steering | 2 percent |
| any other system | none |

The credit is taken by multiplying the amount by one less the credit, before the payment is compared with the coverage remaining.

*Hypothetical:* a transmission repair amount of 3000.00 becomes 2880.00; a steering repair amount of 1200.00 becomes 1176.00; a brake repair amount stays as it is.
